messages:
lina: Quick report from onboarding: we have a reproducible issue where OTEL http instrumentation is collecting `x-user-email` into span attributes before our redaction middleware runs, and separate requests with that header sometimes cause logs to be emitted at TRACE level instead of INFO. Repro steps below. Anyone seen this pattern?

omar: yes, saw similar in another project. OTEL captures headers early. Can you paste your boot order + redaction middleware?

lina: boot order: load config -> require('./telemetry').init() -> init logger -> express app -> app.use(redact) -> routes. redact middleware:```js
module.exports = (req,res,next)=>{ if(req.headers['x-user-email']) delete req.headers['x-user-email']; next(); }```
But OTEL still shows the header in span.attrs and logs derived from span attrs.

frida: two things: (1) auto-instrumentation registers at require/init time and reads headers before app middleware, (2) some pretty-printers merge span attributes into log records, which explains the email appearing in stdout. The TRACE level could be from instrumentation internals or a child logger receiving a different level via inherited state.

olmar: (typo) omar: small nit: is your logger creating child instances in middleware? that has caused level/serializer races previously.

lina: yes we do `req.log = logger.child({ reqId })` in middleware. When I remove that child creation the TRACE noise goes away, but that's not a great UX for users.

omar: immediate fixes: (A) configure HttpInstrumentation with a requestHook to scrub headers before they become attributes, (B) move redaction earlier than OTEL init (call redact hook from boot) or (C) avoid child loggers in request-scope. Example requestHook:```js
new HttpInstrumentation({ requestHook: (span, req) => { span.setAttribute('http.request.header.x-user-email', undefined); } })
```

frida: also add an OTEL span processor that drops sensitive attributes as a fallback. That will help for deployments where you can't change boot order.

lina: tried requestHook approach, it works locally but in our serverless emulation the requestHook doesn't run consistently (race). Also adding a span processor fixed the span attributes but logs still sometimes show TRACE lines.

omar: TRACE lines probably due to logger child-level race. Which logger? pino? bunyan?

lina: pino v8 + pino-pretty in dev. Example weird lines:```
INFO  api GET /v1/me { reqId: 'r-101', userEmail: 'alice@acct.com' }
TRACE api db query start { reqId: 'r-101' }
```
Notice userEmail present and unpredictable TRACE.

frida: pino child loggers can inherit serializers/timestamp fns lazily; combined with OTEL monkeypatching console/time helpers at runtime you can see mixed behavior. Two practical DX recommendations for sampleapp: 1) don't attach persistent child loggers in middleware; instead call `logger.info({ reqId })` at call site, 2) default sampleapp OTEL config should set `HttpInstrumentation.requestHook` to sanitize headers and include a span processor that scrubs attrs. Also surface this in onboarding notes.

omar: agree. Add a smoke test in CI that runs a repro harness: start sampleapp with OTEL enabled + send requests with `x-user-email` and assert no sensitive header in span attributes and no TRACE-level logs for normal endpoints.

lina: opened PR with repro + doc update: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/123 - recommends logger pattern and OTEL config.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-3501: "Telemetry redaction race: OTEL captures headers before app redaction + child logger level races" https://tracker/redwood/DEVEX-3501

frida: Also note we should ship a small code snippet in the Quickstart that shows a safe logging pattern and a one-liner to enable the OTEL sanitizer. Saves support noise.

omar: I'll add the CI smoke test and a sample `otel.config.js` that sets requestHook + simple span processor. If ops sees this in staging we'll escalate.

lina: thanks everyone. I'll land PR once CI smoke passes and update onboarding checklist: "If you see secrets in logs/traces: check OTEL requestHook, boot order, and avoid child loggers in middleware."

ops-bot: Notified eng-infra and security on DEVEX-3501.
